zh.label: 最新版本
zh.title: 矩形标注可移动
changes: 使用矩形工具时，可以直接按住已有矩形并整体拖动
拖动过程提供手型光标、选中框和实时位置预览
移动后的矩形保持原有尺寸并限制在截图范围内，且支持一次撤销恢复
应用、Sparkle 更新 ZIP 和手动安装 DMG 均已签名并通过 Apple 公证

en.label: Latest
en.title: Movable rectangle annotations
changes: With the Rectangle tool active, you can press and drag an existing rectangle to move it as a whole.
A hand cursor, selection outline, and live position preview provide clear feedback while dragging.
Moved rectangles retain their size, stay within the captured image, and can be restored with one Undo.
The app, Sparkle update ZIP, and manual-install DMG are signed and notarized by Apple.
